name: CSAT
summary: The shared thumbs up/down satisfaction prompt — the one CSAT control, not a bespoke rating.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-csat> — the reusable form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule. A binary thumbs-up/down prompt with a required `source` for typo-proof analytics segmentation; it emits a composed `rate` event. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the thumbs are the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME and the selected/hover states animate on PERSISTENT button nodes (class toggle, no rebuild). Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for the `rate` event; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: a lightweight satisfaction check on a feature or a piece of content
a full-block outcome after an operation
you need structured, multi-field feedback with validation

opinion.note: Use the shared control — never build a bespoke rating. Always pass a stable `source` per placement so segmentation stays typo-proof. Keep it to the binary thumbs; ask for free-text only after a thumbs-down, and never block rendering on tracking.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the feedback pattern's CSAT rule (parts/feedback.guide.md): a binary thumbs widget with a required source token. Colours + motion map to the token layer. A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The card probe is pre-rated (value='up') so the selected colour + the aria-pressed a11y contract are measurable; a second [data-probe-inline] probe (inline, value='up') pins the compact single-row layout — the muted #4A4A4A prompt, the borderless 16px thumb icon-button, and that aria-pressed still syncs inline.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-csat[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var p=r&&r.querySelector('.prompt');var u=r&&r.querySelector('.up');var d=r&&r.querySelector('.down');var b=r&&r.querySelector('.btn');var sp=p?getComputedStyle(p):null;var su=u?getComputedStyle(u):null;var sb=b?getComputedStyle(b):null;var iel=document.querySelector('aha-csat[data-probe-inline]');var ir=iel&&iel.shadowRoot;var ip=ir&&ir.querySelector('.prompt');var iu=ir&&ir.querySelector('.up');var ib=ir&&ir.querySelector('.btn');var iic=iu&&iu.querySelector('aha-icon');var sip=ip?getComputedStyle(ip):null;var sib=ib?getComputedStyle(ib):null;return{promptColor:sp?sp.color:null,upColor:su?su.color:null,btnWidth:sb?sb.width:null,btnHeight:sb?sb.height:null,upPressed:u?u.getAttribute('aria-pressed'):null,downPressed:d?d.getAttribute('aria-pressed'):null,inlinePromptColor:sip?sip.color:null,inlineBtnWidth:sib?sib.width:null,inlineIconSize:iic?iic.getAttribute('size'):null,inlineUpPressed:iu?iu.getAttribute('aria-pressed'):null};})()
